title: Talk it through 2.2
role: Tour guide helping a traveler at a bus station, a bank and a border post
can_do: I can arrange travel or accommodation and handle a simple transaction.
I can answer an official's basic questions.

nodes.partner_line: Good morning. I'd like two tickets to the capital, please.
nodes.translation: Buenos días. Quisiera dos boletos a la capital, por favor.

options.text: Sure. Do you want the morning bus or the night bus?

nodes.partner_line: A return ticket, please. How much is it?
nodes.translation: Ida y vuelta, por favor. ¿Cuánto cuesta?
nodes.model_reply: It is thirty dollars in total.

nodes.partner_line: Can I pay by card, or only in cash?
nodes.translation: ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta o solo en efectivo?

options.text: I'm afraid it's cash only here.

nodes.partner_line: Excuse me. What is the exchange rate for dollars today?
nodes.translation: Disculpe. ¿Cuál es el tipo de cambio del dólar hoy?

options.text: Today it's four thousand pesos to the dollar.
I'll check it for you. One moment, please.
It changes every morning. Do you want to see the board?

nodes.partner_line: Welcome. What is the purpose of your visit?
nodes.translation: Bienvenido. ¿Cuál es el motivo de su visita?

options.text: I'm here for a business meeting.

nodes.partner_line: How long are you going to stay in the country?
nodes.translation: ¿Cuánto tiempo va a quedarse en el país?

options.text: Until the end of the month.
